docs.summary: A single control point on an [`AnimationCurve`](#api~Prowl.Vector.AnimationCurve). Holds up to four components; a curve only reads the first [`Dimension`](#api~Prowl.Vector.AnimationCurve~Dimension) of them.
docs.remarks: Tangents are slopes in value units per second, matching glTF `CUBICSPLINE` samplers, so a tangent of 2 always means rising by 2 per second regardless of how far apart the keys sit.
